text:
Maya Patel: Quick thread 1: post-launch hotlist update. Three customer-facing items popped up: (A) Acme streaming p99 regression, (B) Beta onboarding flow tweak, (C) embeddings schema mismatch for OneCorp. Need to decide what goes in the next micro-release (2w).
Dan Chen: Can we quantify the Acme impact? single-customer vs multi-tenant?
Vishal Rao: It's concentrated on Acme long-stream requests (>1k tokens). Their call mix shows ~8% of requests hit the regression. p99 latency jumped ~800ms -> ~2s. Logs and repro in #eng-runtime.
Maya Patel: Given Acme is on a trial SLA, I'd prioritize. Srini, can you estimate a patch?
Srini Iyer: Estimate: 1d to pinpoint root cause (likely KV cache miss + batch edge-case) + 1d for fix/tests + 0.5d canary and verification = 2.5d. I can target a cherry-picked hotfix to stable.
Liz Gomez: QE note: we need the streaming regression pack and a dedicated-pool smoke. I can run the suite if we have a PR by EOD tomorrow. Recommend 6h canary window with token-level traces.
Dan Chen: Rollback criteria suggestion: if streaming p99 >1.5s or error rate >0.5% sustained for 15m, auto-rollback. I'll author a dashboard tile + runbook fragment.
Maya Patel: What about the Beta onboarding tweak? Risk vs reward?
Liz Gomez: Beta PM requests it for their cohort tests next week. It's a UI/feature-flaggable change. Low risk if behind flag.
Vishal Rao: I'd rather not expand scope during a hotfix deploy. Proposal: ship Acme-only; gate Beta behind flag and only flip after canary passes 8h.
Srini Iyer: Agreed. Plan: push Acme PR to stable branch, run canary on subset of dedicated nodes, then optionally enable Beta flag post-verification.
release-bot: Release checklist updated: hotfix branch created (hotfix/kv-cache-acme-1797654321). CI queued.
Maya Patel: Action list: Srini owns hotfix PR and cherry-pick (target PR by TOM EOD), Liz owns QE run and canary, Dan prepares rollback dashboards and runbook, Maya will draft Acme CSM note.
Liz Gomez: I'll schedule QE and post timestamps / pass/fail in this thread.
Dan Chen: I'll add the runbook snippet to the PR and the alert thresholds to the canary dashboard.
Maya Patel: Decision: ship Acme-only unless QA gives explicit green within 8 hours post-canary to also include Beta behind flag. Otherwise Beta goes to backlog slot next sprint.
Srini Iyer: PR will include cherry-pick command and commit sha. Example: 
```
git checkout stable
git cherry-pick -x 3f9a12b
```
Maya Patel: Thanks all. I'll update the release board and ping the Beta PM about gating.
release-bot: Note: next micro-release window opens in 5 business days.
